name: dumbbell alternating bicep curl with leg raised on exercise ball
description: Alternating dumbbell curls with one leg lifted while sitting on an exercise ball. It trains the biceps and challenges balance.
instructions: Sit tall on a stability ball with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Straighten one leg and lift that foot off the floor.
Curl one dumbbell toward your shoulder, keeping the elbow at your side.
Lower it slowly while you curl the other.
Keep alternating arms; lift the other leg on the next set.
